summary: Lightspeed Commerce Inc., a Montreal-based foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its interim financial statements and MD&A for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO Form 52-109F2 certifications under Canadian rules. No transaction, shareholder, or corporate-action event is disclosed. Figures show Q2 revenue of $323.8M versus $319.0M, gross profit of $142.8M, operating loss narrowing to $7.8M from $36.7M, and cash of $342.9M; exhibits are incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 registration statements. Nothing to arbitrage.
